## 7-Step Agentic Org Maturity Ladder Reference
1. Step 1: Tool Adoption (Human-Run Silos)
2. Step 2: Domain-Separated Context Layer (Scoped MCP Gateways)
3. Step 3: Harness Engineering (Golden Datasets & Model-Agnostic Routers)
4. Step 4: Go Headless (Unattended Mutex Daemons & State Ledgers)
5. Step 5: Lifecycle & Access Governance (Per-Tool RBAC & 90-Day TTL)
6. Step 6: Quality-Gated Agent-to-Agent Handoffs (Contract Envelopes & Independent Judges)
7. Step 7: Step Functions (80-95% Agent Volume + 5-20% Human Exception Queues)
